name: Chris Ford
bio: Chris Ford is Chief Executive Officer, and previously President (2017–2019), of the Astronomical Society of the Pacific, and serves on the advisory board of Lowell Observatory. He is also a leading authority in CGI and visualization technology, having held leadership roles at Pixar, Roblox, Autodesk, and Alias|Wavefront, with work recognized by three Scientific and Technical Academy Awards. He brings a wide range of telescopes—from a 24" Newtonian to refractors—for public astronomy outreach.
